name: The Manbreaker
source:
A female domination themed visual novel set in a brutal medieval world. 

Encounter a unique half-elf, half-orc antagonist who stands apart from her kin with her immense strength and a sharp, calculating mind.

[From [url=https://mortedara.itch.io/the-manbreaker-femdom-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部以女性统治为主题的视觉小说，背景设定在残酷的中世纪世界。

遭遇一位独特的半精灵半兽人对手，她凭借强大的力量和敏锐而精于算计的头脑，与她的亲属区分开来。

[来自[url=https://mortedara.itch.io/the-manbreaker-femdom-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
